label: GeoComputation and SIRC meet in Dunedin
summary: The University of Otago hosted the second International Conference on GeoComputation from 26 to 29 August 1997. Its proceedings, initially published on CD-ROM, name authors of New Zealand and international spatial-computing research.

sources.label: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on GeoComputation, University of Otago, 26–29 August 1997
